'''Phrojo Nuray''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|hired gun]] who was considered infamous throughout the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] by the time of the [[Third Galactic War]]. Having earned more than enough [[Credit chip/Legends|credits]] to retire, he continued his mercenary work purely for the sport of it, and decided to offer his services to whoever won his contract in a jackpot at a [[Slot machine/Legends|slot machine]] in one of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa's]] famed [[Casino/Legends|casinos]]. When the [[Alliance Commander]] won his contract, he joined the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="KOTET" />
